claims.claim: Normal matching first floods same-color orthogonal connectivity, marks horizontal and vertical runs meeting minErase, then counts marked connected neighbours before actual removal.
claims.qualification: The traversal marks its seed visited even when unmarked, follows only neighbours with flags&3==2, and the classifier rechecks actual runs. Do not equate a preliminary counter or special transient state with an arbitrary pure marked-set oracle.

claims.claim: The marked count must reach max(impl signed16+0xB6264, signed16+0xB626C) when that maximum is positive. minErase and minMatch are distinct.
claims.qualification: The native reader accepts nonnegative values at most board size and rejects other unsigned representations. This is stricter than the native signed-value gate; no negative live value was observed or used to justify relaxing validation.

claims.claim: T, cross and L use actual removed count exactly 5; square uses exactly 9. L and T have four directional checks. Unmarked same-color boundary neighbours are not universally forbidden.
claims.qualification: Confirmed stable normal-group geometry; special excluded flags, removal animation states and every downstream awakening effect are not fully modeled by this claim.

claims.claim: Four-orb consumers test actual removed count==4, including a separate heart-color branch. Under supported minErase>=3 a connected removable size-four group can only be a straight four.
claims.qualification: Straight-four equivalence is a deduction from supported run marking plus size four, not evidence of a dedicated native four-shape flag. Heart recovery amount and all latent/awakening qualifications are outside this claim.

claims.claim: A row flag allows a removed group containing a full-width row. A native column flag requires minX==maxX and count>=height. Ordinary product Column deliberately also accepts removed side branches; bonusFirstWave Column is strict.
claims.qualification: Do not silently change saved ordinary Column goal semantics to match the awakening flag.

claims.claim: The motion gate invokes matching; drop preparation compacts remaining orbs and prepares new colors, with a suppression branch setting new orbs to state6. Settled boards can re-enter matching. The shape classifier is not intrinsically first-wave-only.
claims.qualification: Only existing-orb deterministic cascades are simulated. Random/fixed generated skyfalls, all no-skyfall predicate sources and downstream per-awakening wave-scoping were not fully audited. Product first-wave goal restrictions are conservative policy, not universal native awakening rules.

claims.claim: A currently active unmatchable-color table is checked before same-color flooding.
claims.qualification: The reader validates durations and masks before allowing planning; this audit does not relax invalid encodings.

claims.claim: Multiple spinners are native-supported and each cell obeys state/lock eligibility under the shared clock; movement can make their phase histories diverge. Desired colors come from current goals and the actual shared allowed-color table.
claims.qualification: No new device timing evidence or broader special-color support is asserted here.
